name: Local Orchestrator / Agent
purpose: A bounded, ReAct-style LOCAL agent loop: given a natural-language goal it decides which Module (tool) to call, generates that tool's arguments, invokes it, observes the result, and repeats until the goal is finished or a hard step budget is reached. It is the frontier agent's tool loop done locally, to offload orchestration off the scarce weekly frontier allotment. DECISIONS ('which tool next, or finish?') route THROUGH logic.escalator (#19) as a closed-set classify task (labels = the registered tool names + 'finish'), so the escalator's deterministic in-set gate guarantees a valid action and its tiny->weak->mid ladder does the cost-offload; ARGUMENT GENERATION and the FINAL ANSWER use model.gateway (#7); TOOLS are conforming Modules invoked as child skills (the image.index #18 spawn-and-parse-envelope pattern) from a curated declarative closed registry (tools.json; ships doc.io/fs.observer/capture.screen/ocr.layout/detect.objects/image.interpret/speech.stt/audio.ingest/gen.image/gen.music/fs.manage). A tool may set resolve_paths:false (e.g. fs.manage) to receive its path arguments verbatim (so known folders like 'desktop', ~, and %ENV% survive); otherwise relative path-like args are resolved against working_dir. With -Route, route.tools (#27) is called FIRST to pre-select the minimal toolset for the goal and the ReAct loop is CONSTRAINED to that subset (falling back to the full set if the router returns nothing); the selection is surfaced as result.planned_tools. Guardrails: a hard max_steps budget, a -DryRun plan-preview that invokes nothing, and needs_frontier surfaced as a status field. ORCHESTRATOR, NOT a review-queue producer: it redirects every child's review writes to an in-artifact child_review.jsonl and never writes the canonical review_queue.jsonl.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Goal <string> [-WorkingDir <dir>] [-MaxSteps <int, default 4>] [-DryRun] [-DecisionTiers <alias array, default [tiny,weak,mid]>] [-GenTier <alias, default mid>] [-FrontierThreshold <default 0.5>] [-MaxObservationChars <default 600>] [-MaxTranscriptChars <default 4000>] [-Temperature <default 0.0>] [-Seed <default 42>] [-MaxTokens <default 512>] [-Route] [-RouteToolsPath] [-RouteTier <alias, default mid>]; plumbing [-ToolsPath <tools.json>] [-Tools <json>] [-EscalatorPath] [-GatewayPath] [-Registry <models.json>] [-PwshPath] [-LoadTimeoutSec] [-ReviewQueuePath]. OR -InputsJson '<json {goal,working_dir,max_steps,dry_run,route,route_tools_path,route_tier,decision_tiers,gen_tier,frontier_threshold,max_observation_chars,max_transcript_chars,temperature,seed,max_tokens,tools_path,tools,escalator_path,gateway_path,registry,pwsh_path,load_timeout_s,review_queue_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.description: The natural-language task for the local agent to accomplish.

inputs.name: working_dir
inputs.description: A base directory the agent operates in; a relative path-like tool argument (path/input/output/out/file/dest) the model emits is resolved against it.

inputs.name: max_steps
inputs.description: Hard cap on tool-selection+invocation steps. Exhausting it stops with status=stopped and needs_frontier=true.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Plan-preview: run the decide+arg-generate steps and record the intended tool+args per step but invoke NO tool (no file is written).

inputs.name: route
inputs.description: Pre-select the toolset via route.tools (#27) FIRST, then constrain the ReAct loop to that subset (falls back to the full set if the router returns nothing). Surfaced as result.planned_tools / result.route.

inputs.name: route_tools_path
inputs.description: Path to Invoke-RouteTools.ps1 (default: resolved from modules/27-route-tools). Used only with route.

inputs.name: route_tier
inputs.description: The model.gateway tier route.tools uses for the router pass (mid; never strong).

inputs.name: decision_tiers
inputs.description: The logic.escalator ladder used for the tool-selection decision (excludes the 27B strong, which emits empty verdicts at MVP token caps - D-0030).

inputs.name: gen_tier
inputs.description: The model.gateway tier used for argument generation and the final answer.

inputs.name: frontier_threshold
inputs.description: Passed to the escalator; a per-step decision below this sets needs_frontier (a status signal; NOT a review-queue write or a frontier call).

inputs.name: max_observation_chars
inputs.description: Cap on each tool observation appended to the transcript.

inputs.name: max_transcript_chars
inputs.description: Cap on the transcript text shown to the model per step (kept within the escalator's max_input_chars).

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.description: Greedy temperature for the decision, arg-generation, and final-answer calls.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: RNG seed passed to the escalator/gateway.

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Generation cap for argument generation (the final answer is capped tighter).

inputs.name: tools_path
inputs.description: Path to a tool registry JSON (default: the skill's own tools.json).

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: An inline tool registry array (overrides tools_path). Each entry: {tool, skill_id, entrypoint, description, args_hint, args_example, required[], side_effecting}.

inputs.name: escalator_path
inputs.description: Path to Invoke-LogicEscalator.ps1 (default: resolved from modules/19-logic-escalator).

inputs.name: gateway_path
inputs.description: Path to Invoke-ModelGateway.ps1 (default: resolved from modules/07-model-gateway).

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Path to the gateway's models.json (passed through to the escalator + gateway).

inputs.name: pwsh_path
inputs.description: pwsh executable used to spawn child skills (default the dotnet-tool pwsh).

inputs.name: load_timeout_s
inputs.description: Override the child gateway server load timeout (raise for a cold strong tier).

inputs.name: review_queue_path
inputs.description: Relocates the in-artifact sink for redirected child review writes. This skill is not a review-queue producer and never writes the canonical review_queue.jsonl.

outputs.description: { goal, working_dir, status: completed|stopped|error, final_answer, needs_frontier, stop_reason, step_count, max_steps, dry_run, route_enabled, planned_tools:[ids]|null, route:{enabled,entrypoint_found,applied,fell_back,planned_tools,route_status,route_confidence,full_tool_count,constrained_tool_count,route_gateway_calls,route_tokens,route_runtime_ms}, outcome:{tools_invoked,tools_succeeded,tools_failed,succeeded_tools,failed_tools}, tools_available:[{tool,skill_id,side_effecting}], steps:[ {index, decision:{chosen_tool,confidence,accepted_tier,accepted_via,needs_frontier,ok}, args, args_raw, tool:{skill_id,invoked,status,error,artifact_dir}, observation, error} ], cost:{decision_calls,gen_calls,tool_calls,route_calls,total_gateway_calls,total_tokens,total_runtime_ms}, decision_tiers, gen_tier, review:{mode,child_review_path,child_review_count,is_producer:false}, is_review_producer:false, child_reviews_redirected_to }. planned_tools/route reflect the -Route pre-pass; outcome is a deterministic grounding of what actually ran (the final answer must not over-claim beyond it). confidence = min per-step decision confidence (null if none). model_provenance = the stage-tagged aggregate of every child route/decision/gen/tool call.

models: the wired GGUF LLM tiers via logic.escalator + model.gateway (tiny/weak/mid)
